decision.observation: 11:50 am; the rod is drawn but no bobber or line is visible in the pond below the farmer. He stands above the pond's north rim.
decision.hypothesis: The cast didn't land in water (bobber may be off-screen or the cast aimed elsewhere); recasting while facing south should place it in the pond.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, LMB holds/releases keep the green bar on the fish. Catches ship via the porch bin for overnight gold.
